text: Zombie apocalypse at a theme park. Part four.
The helicopter hovers over the wheel. One seat. One cable.
And the rotor is pulling every infected in the park back to her.
Rule number one said, they can't climb. It never said they can't pile.
They stack against the leg of the wheel. Ten feet. Twenty. Thirty.
Gus says, the kid goes. Nora looks at his knees.
Rule number five. The one who can't run, goes first.
She clips him into the harness. He complains the whole way up.
Pickles goes with him. A goose doesn't count as a seat.
Then the pilot, on channel four. We're out of fuel. Back in forty minutes.
The helicopter leaves. The noise leaves with it.
It's sixty feet tall. It grows one foot a minute.
The hub is at one hundred.
And in her pocket, Nora still has the remote.
